content.title: MP Materials Stock Gets Another Upgrade. The Outlook Is Bright.
content.summary: Rare-earth stocks have taken it on the chin in recent weeks regardless of the enormous gains unleashed by America’s desire to end its dependence on Chinese critical minerals.  As the stocks fall, Wall Street is becoming more bullish on shares of  MP Materials  the largest rare-earth producer in the Western Hemisphere.  Coming into Friday trading, shares of MP were down 42% over the past month, but up 269% this year.

content.title: JPMorgan lifts MP Materials on ‘unmatched earnings visibility’
content.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan upgraded MP Materials to Overweight from Neutral, arguing that investors are overlooking what the firm calls the company’s “underappreciated national security importance and unmatched earnings visibility.”

content.title: USA Rare Earth Falls After Deal Approval. What’s Next for the Trade.
content.summary: USA Rare Earth  stock fell on Wednesday despite the company announcing U.K. approval for its purchase of the manufacturer Less Common Metals.  USA Rare Earth stock traded as high as $18.56 but closed at $16.92, down 4.8%, while the  and  gained 0.1% and 0.7%, respectively.  The company, which is developing a rare-earth mine in Texas, agreed to buy Less Common Metals, a U.K.-based manufacturer of specialized rare-earth metals and alloys, for $100 million and 6.74 million shares in September.
